name: My toilet flushes weakly; what causes this?

mainEntity.name: My toilet flushes weakly; what causes this?

acceptedAnswer.text: A weak flush often indicates insufficient water flow or pressure. This could be due to a partially closed water supply valve, a worn-out flapper that doesn't stay open long enough, or sediment buildup in the rim jets under the toilet bowl's rim. Another common cause is a partial blockage in the trap or drain line. Addressing a weak flush often improves toilet efficiency. If you're experiencing this in Goodyear, Buckeye, Avondale, Surprise, or Waddel, Alpha-Plumbing Services can diagnose and resolve it.
acceptedAnswer.description: Weak flushing is often caused by low water flow, a faulty flapper, or sediment in the rim jets. A partial blockage can also be a factor.
